name: Central Square with Four Private Leaf Squares
definition: On coordinates 0,...,5, encode x by sum_i 2^i x_i. The complete word set is [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 16, 18, 33, 35].
properties: ACC: the central square and four leaves have a star join tree. The leaf cubes form an induced four-cycle in the maximal-cube intersection graph.
